title: 第206章 不是你你真走啊第205章 放开了
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 庞威、熊老三、胡鸠眼睁睁望着陈鸿远沉尸水底，几圈涟漪在江面荡开，终归于无。
庞威面皮狠抽，拳头攥得咯吱作响，心中犹自不敢相信：
‘老六…就这么没了？！’
‘他可是暗劲中期的修为！白骨销魂手浸淫多年，不知撕碎了多少好手咽喉！’
‘可在此子面前，三招都没能走完，便被一爪捏碎了脖子，像…杀鸡一样！”
三人面色铁青，心中惊怒不已，却迟迟没有动作，心中已对这青年的实力忌惮十足！
不远处。
轰！
段红绫与丁翃对拼一记，两股暗劲轰然相撞，江水被震得炸起一道数丈高的水幕。
两人各自连退三步，落脚礁石被卸去的余劲踩得寸寸碎裂。
段红绫喘了口气，胸口起伏，美眸惊异地转动着，心中翻涌起浓浓的不可置信。
‘这位沈师弟…实力竟如此之强！’
‘身份令牌上分明言其暗劲三窍，可方才他展现出的战力，绝非那般简单！’
她后知后觉地反应过来…
苍梧六魔在此处仅出现了五人。
那剩下的一个…
恐怕便是方才马车旁，那个被沈修寒一爪毙于掌下的尸首。
‘丁翃等人都在此处，所以是…’
段红绫眼泛惊骇，难以置信地想到：
‘先除翁桧、后斩陈鸿远！’
‘苍梧六魔，他独折其二！’
‘这位沈师弟…到底什么来头！？’
“好胆！”
丁翃目光同样锁在了沈修寒身上。
他瞳孔中戾芒暴闪，面上横肉因狂怒而剧烈抖动着，当机立断，暴喝道：
“二弟！先不用上岛拿宝鱼了，合力诛杀此獠，为老六报仇！”
他心中已泛起一丝焦躁。
千池岛距摘星门最近的听泉岛，乘快船也需近两个时辰。
原本这时辰绰绰有余。
拿了宝鱼，宰了追兵，大可从容脱身，天高地远，谁也追查不到。
可谁曾想…
半路杀出这么一个闻所未闻的愣头青！
看上去不过十七八岁，不甚出奇的模样，出手却狠辣果决得令人发指。
丁翃心底第一次升起一股隐隐的不安。
‘必须速战速决，不能再拖了！’
三人显然也领会了丁翃的意思。
庞威深吸一口气，转头厉声道：
“卢照元！你与我等一同…”
话到一半，戛然而止。
庞威面上瞬间挂满了愕然。
原本站在他们身后的卢照元，不知何时已不见了踪影！
content_en:
"..."
Pang Wei, Xiong Laosan, and Hu Jiu watched helplessly as Chen Hongyuan's body sank to the bottom of the water. Several ripples spread across the river, and finally disappeared.
Pang Wei's face twitched fiercely, his fists clenched loudly, and he still couldn't believe it in his heart:
‘Lao Liu… is just gone? ! ’
‘He is at the middle stage of Anjin’s cultivation! The bones have been immersed in ecstasy for many years, and I don’t know how many good hands have torn the throats into pieces! ’
'But in front of this guy, he couldn't finish the three moves, and his neck was crushed by a claw, like...killing a chicken! "
The three people's faces were livid, and they were shocked and angry, but they did not make any move. They were already very afraid of this young man's strength!
Not far away.
Boom!
Duan Hongling and Ding Hong fought each other, and the two dark forces collided with each other, causing the river to explode into a water curtain several feet high.
The two of them each took three steps back, and the rock they landed on was shattered inch by inch by the force that had been removed.
Duan Hongling took a breath, her chest heaved, her beautiful eyes turned in surprise, and a deep sense of disbelief surged in her heart.
‘This Junior Brother Shen… is so powerful! ’
‘The identity token clearly states that he has three hidden powers, but the combat power he showed just now is by no means that simple! ’
She reacted belatedly...
Only five of the Cangwu Six Demons appeared here.
The remaining one...
I'm afraid it's the corpse that was killed by Shen Xiuhan's claw next to the carriage just now.
'Ding Hong and others are all here, so...'
‘Weng Hui! ? ’
Duan Hongling's eyes were filled with horror, and she thought in disbelief:
‘First get rid of Weng Hui, then kill Chen Hongyuan! ’
‘He alone defeated two of Cangwu’s six demons! ’
‘What is the origin of this Junior Brother Shen? ? ’
"How brave! "
Ding Hong's eyes were also locked on Shen Xiuhan.
His pupils flashed fiercely, and the flesh on his face trembled violently with rage. He made a sudden decision and shouted:
"Second brother! There is no need to go to the island to get the treasure fish, let’s work together to kill this beast and avenge Lao Liu! "
There was already a hint of anxiety in his heart.
Thousand Chi Island is the closest Tingquan Island to the Star Gate, and it takes nearly two hours by speedboat.
Originally this time was more than enough.
After taking the treasure fish and killing the pursuers, you can escape easily. The sky is high and the sky is far away, and no one can trace it.
But who would have thought...
Such an unheard-of stupid young man appeared halfway!
He looked to be no more than seventeen or eighteen years old, and his appearance was not unusual, but his attacks were ruthless and decisive.
For the first time, a faint uneasiness arose in Ding Hong's heart.
‘We must fight quickly, we can’t delay it any longer! ’
The three of them obviously understood what Ding Hong meant.
Pang Wei took a deep breath, turned around and said sharply:
"Lu Zhaoyuan! You and I will wait together..."
Halfway through his words, he stopped abruptly.
Pang Wei's face was instantly filled with astonishment.
Lu Zhaoyuan, who was originally standing behind them, disappeared without knowing it!
title_en: Chapter 206: It’s not you, why should you really leave? Chapter 205: Let go
